## 2. Positioning Narrative (use this to set the tone across the whole site)

Sudesh operates at the intersection of three roles:
1. **Founder** — builds and runs real ventures (Induxtron, Vennova, Arihant Art Gallery), with direct ownership of product, technical execution, and business strategy.
2. **AI Engineer** — ships working AI-integrated software independently: RAG systems, LLM-powered automation tools, ML models, and a published NLP research paper.
3. **Product

Strategist** — thinks in terms of business outcomes (ROI, retention, conversion, win-rate) rather than just code, evidenced by Induxtron's results-driven systems and Vennova's role-based product design philosophy.

This positioning should read as **credible and grounded, not inflated** — back every claim with a specific, real example (a metric, a system, a deployed link) rather than a generic superlative. The portfolio needs to work simultaneously as:
- A **business portfolio** — for prospectiv

e clients evaluating Induxtron/Arihant Art Gallery or considering hiring Sudesh's team for an AI/software project.
- A **freelance portfolio** — for clients hiring Sudesh directly for web development, custom software, or AI integration work.
- A **job/internship portfolio** — for recruiters/companies (e.g., AI/ML or full-stack roles) evaluating his technical depth and research background.

A single "Services" or "Work with me" section plus a "Projects" section with tagged categories (Founder Ven

ture / Client-Ready Product / Research / Independent Build) can let one site serve all three audiences without contradiction.

, with a focus on measurable ROI within 90 days.
- **Five core AI systems offered:**

  2. **CertAlert** (Revenue Protection) — prevents missed calibration-certificate renewals; reported renewal rate improvement 65% → 88%; build time 3–5 weeks.
  3. **IndustrialBot** (24×7 Sales Agent) — an always-on website sales agent; reported conversion improvement 0.5%

→ 8%; build time 3–4 weeks.
  4. **TenderRadar** (Tender Intelligence) — tracks GeM government tenders so none are missed; associated impact figure ₹135L/year; build time 5–7 weeks.
  5. **ChurnRadar** (Retention AI) — predicts client churn before it happens; reported churn reduction 15% → 7%; build time 4–6 weeks.
- **Positioning:** "Where Industry Meets Intelligence." Operates on a selective, application-only client model — "We work with the few, not the many." Currently has active clients and

limited open application spots.
- **Registration:** UDYAM-MH-04-0296135, based in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra.
- **Sudesh's role:** Co-Founder [CONFIRM — the public site's listed contact is sahil@induxtron.com; confirm how to present Sudesh's specific role/title alongside any co-founder(s) for accuracy].

ould be a flagship feature on the business-facing side of the portfolio.

## 8. Research / Publications

### "Sentiment Analysis of Product Reviews Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Study with Negation Handling"
- Authored and presented original research at a national-level conference.
- Compared five ML models: Random Forest, Logistic Regression, SVM, Naïve Bayes, KNN.
- Dataset: Restaurant Reviews dataset.
- Core finding: comparing two negation-handling strategi

es, preserving negation words during text preprocessing improved sentiment classification accuracy by 2–9.5% across all models.
- Random Forest achieved the highest accuracy: 83.5%.
- Methods used: tokenization, stemming, Bag-of-Words feature engineering, accuracy/confusion-matrix evaluation.
- **Use in portfolio:** Strong evidence for the "AI Engineer" identity — real applied NLP research, not just project work.

## 9. Independent Projects

### AutoScribe — AI-Powered Documentation Automat

ion for GitHub Repositories
- **Current status:** Version 1 (v1) released/stable; Sudesh is planning to evolve it into a dev tool product (i.e., a tool other developers could adopt, not just a personal project) — frame as an active, evolving product rather than a finished/closed project.
- **What it does:** Connects to GitHub via OAuth, analyzes codebases, and automatically generates/maintains documentation so it never goes stale.
- **Key features:**
  - GitHub OAuth integration
  - AST-based co

de analysis via Tree-sitter (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript)
  - AI-generated READMEs and function-level docstrings (Groq LLM — Llama 3, Mixtral)
  - Staleness detection (SHA-256 file hash comparison, AST structure tracking)
  - Incremental updates — only regenerates changed docs (70–90% cost/time reduction)
  - GitHub webhook support (auto-triggered doc updates on push, HMAC-verified)
  - Semantic search + RAG-based Q&A over codebase (FAISS + SentenceTransformers)
  - Customizable/previewable d

oc-generation prompts
  - Analytics dashboard (coverage %, staleness counts, doc health scores)
- **Tech stack:** React 19, TypeScript 6, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS 3.4 (frontend); FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0 (backend); SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL 16 (prod); GitHub OAuth 2.0; Celery 5.4 + Redis 7 (background jobs); Groq API; Tree-sitter 0.21; FAISS 1.8 + SentenceTransformers 3.0; APScheduler 3.10; GitPython 3.1; Alembic (migrations); Docker; GitHub Actions (CI/CD)
- **Considered the flagship independent tec

hnical project.**

### DocuMind-AI — Full-Stack RAG for Intelligent Document QA
- **What it does:** Multi-document RAG application for AI-powered Q&A over uploaded documents, organized into workspaces.
- **Key features:**
  - Multi-format upload: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT
  - Hybrid retrieval: BM25 keyword search + FAISS semantic search
  - CrossEncoder reranking (graceful fallback if unavailable)
  - Query classification (factual / summary / comparison) with fallback to "factual"
  - Context compres

sion to fit token budgets
  - Source citations with page numbers and snippets, click-to-highlight in UI
  - Workspace system: multiple documents, multi-doc reasoning, rename/delete
  - Streaming chat responses with typing effect
  - Document comparison, detailed explanations, and report generation panels (UI ready)
  - Robust error handling: retries with exponential backoff at every layer
  - Observability: structured JSON logs, latency/token metrics endpoint
  - 27 automated tests (chunking, em

bedding, retrieval, reranking, query classification, context compression)
- **Tech stack:** React 18, Vite, Framer Motion, Lucide Icons (frontend); FastAPI, OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, FAISS, BM25, sentence-transformers, pypdf/python-docx/python-pptx (backend); pytest (testing)

### Diabetes Prediction System (diabetes_ann_app)
- **What it does:** Predicts diabetes risk using an Artificial Neural Network based on 8 health metrics (Pregnancies, Glucose, Blood Pressure, Skin Thickness, Insulin, BMI, Diabe

tes Pedigree Function, Age).
- **Features:** Real-time predictions with probability scoring; patient history tracking (CSV-based); interactive dashboard.
- **Tech stack:** FastAPI, TensorFlow/Keras (ANN model: diabetes_model.h5), NumPy/Pandas/scikit-learn (StandardScaler) on backend; React 19 + Vite on frontend (PatientForm, PatientTable components).
- **API:** POST /predict (returns probability + outcome), GET /patients.
- **Dataset:** Pima Indians Diabetes Database.

### ML Predictive Web Apps

(3 small applied-ML projects)
1. **Study Hours vs Exam Score Predictor** — Linear Regression + Polynomial Regression (degree 2), Flask REST API, plain HTML/CSS/JS frontend. R² = 0.9225 for both models. Dataset: 500 student records.
2. **Salary Predictor** — Random Forest Regression (n_estimators=10), trained on Position_Salaries.csv (10 job levels, Business Analyst → CEO). Flask API + HTML frontend; deployed live at https://salary-prediction-rf.netlify.app/.
3. **AdPredict (Social Network Ads P

redictor)** — Random Forest Classification predicting ad-purchase likelihood from Age + Estimated Salary. 91% accuracy, 84.85% precision, 87.5% recall, 86.15% F1. Deployed live at https://ad-predict.netlify.app/. Dataset: Social_Network_Ads.csv (400 rows).
